MYGD
OPERATIONS & STATION CHECKLISTS
Restaurant Operations Manual
Current opening hours: 11:30-22:00 daily
Opening hours may be adjusted at any time. All opening tasks must be completed before the current opening time.
Version: 24 October 2026
For staff training, shift control and tablet implementation
=====PAGE 2=====
MYGD | OPERATIONS & STATION CHECKLISTS
MYGD | Current opening hours: 11:30-22:00 daily | Hours may be adjusted | Page 2
1. How to Use This Manual
• Each station has an Opening, During Shift, Quiet Period and Closing structure.
• The Register employee is also the Shift Leader / Restaurant Manager and is responsible for overall shift control.
• During peaks, employees should remain on their assigned station unless the Shift Leader reassigns them.
• The operating principle is: Clean - Restock - Prepare - Organise.
• Current opening hours are 11:30-22:00 daily. The system should allow these hours to be changed without rewriting the checklists.
IMPORTANT: For tablet implementation, every task should record the responsible employee, completion status, completion time
and - for critical tasks - Shift Leader verification.
STANDARD PRODUCT FLOW
ORDER → BREAD → SAUCE → SALAD → MEAT → PACKING / EXPEDITOR →
CUSTOMER

2. Restaurant Opening Checklist
IMPORTANT: All opening tasks must be completed before 11:30 under the current opening hours. If opening hours change, the
deadline changes with them.
Restaurant
□ Open the restaurant
□ Open windows for ventilation
□ Turn on all lights
□ Turn on lights in the customer drinks refrigerators
□ Turn on the air conditioning and then close all doors and windows
□ Start the music - Spotify: Chill Out Playlist
□ Check customer area, entrance and outside area are clean and ready
Equipment
□ Turn on all required equipment
□ Prepare the grills
□ Turn on and prepare the fryer
□ Turn on and prepare the Konvektomat
□ Prepare the post-mix machine
□ Check drinks machines
□ Check refrigerators are operating correctly
□ Check salad bar refrigeration
□ Report any equipment fault immediately
Preparation
□ Fully stock the salad bar
□ Fully stock the sauce bar
□ Refill the drinks refrigerator
□ Prepare customer tables
□ Refill napkins, cup lids, straws and customer supplies
□ Refill takeaway and delivery packaging
□ Prepare bread station
□ Prepare meat for first service
□ Prepare fries station
□ Prepare packing / expeditor station
Morning Inventory Check
IMPORTANT: Inventory should use numeric quantity fields, not simple checkboxes. Recommended logic: Last Count → Current
Count → Status (OK / LOW / OUT).
□ Check meat stock
□ Check bread stock
□ Check wraps
□ Check pizza bases
□ Check burger buns
□ Check vegetables and salad ingredients
□ Check fries and side products
=====PAGE 4=====

□ Check sauces and dairy
□ Check pizza ingredients
□ Check drinks and post-mix stock
□ Check packaging and cleaning supplies
□ Review LOW / OUT OF STOCK list and report critical shortages to Shift Leader

3. Register / Shift Leader
Main Responsibility
The Shift Leader is responsible for the overall operation of the restaurant during their shift. They normally work at the Register and
coordinate service, team performance, customer satisfaction, product quality, cash, systems, stock and cleanliness.
OPENING CHECKLIST
Cash Register
□ Open the cash register
□ Count and verify the cash float
□ Ensure sufficient change is available
□ Check card payment terminal
□ Check receipt printer
□ Start POS system
□ Check correct menu and prices are active
Systems
□ Open Foody
□ Open Wolt
□ Open all other delivery platforms
□ Check internet connection
□ Check all order printers
□ Check kitchen display screens / KDS if available
□ Check orders are correctly transmitted to the kitchen
Restaurant Readiness
□ Confirm all stations are ready
□ Check Bread Station
□ Check Sauce Station
□ Check Salad Bar
□ Check Meat / Hot Station
□ Check Fries Station
□ Check Packing / Expeditor Station
□ Check drinks refrigerator
□ Check packaging stock
□ Check napkins, lids and straws
□ Check customer tables and dining area
□ Check cleanliness throughout the restaurant
Team Briefing
□ Confirm all employees are present
□ Assign each employee to a station
□ Explain expected busy periods
□ Explain out-of-stock products
□ Explain special promotions
□ Confirm break schedule
□ Remind staff about Clean As You Go
□ Confirm opening readiness
=====PAGE 6=====
MYGD | OPERATIONS & STATION CHECKLISTS

DURING THE SHIFT
Customer Service
□ Welcome customers in a friendly manner
□ Take orders accurately
□ Enter all special requests correctly into the POS
□ Process payments correctly
□ Handle complaints professionally
□ Make sure customers receive the correct order
□ Maintain excellent customer service
Order Coordination
□ Ensure special requests are correctly entered
□ Ensure kitchen staff can clearly see modifications
□ Monitor order sequence
□ Ensure no order is forgotten
□ Monitor waiting times
□ Prioritise delivery orders correctly
□ Identify dine-in, takeaway and delivery orders correctly
Expeditor / Final Order Control
□ Check order number
□ Check number of products
□ Check special requests
□ Check fries / sides
□ Check drinks
□ Check sauces / extras
□ Check packaging
□ Confirm dine-in / takeaway / delivery
IMPORTANT: During quiet periods, the Shift Leader may also act as Expeditor. During busy periods, a separate employee
should take over the Expeditor position.
Team Management
□ Coordinate the team
□ Monitor all workstations
□ Keep employees on assigned stations during peaks
□ Support employees when required
□ Organise workflow
□ Monitor production speed and waiting times
□ Organise breaks
□ Assign quiet-period tasks
□ Prevent unnecessary standing / waiting
□ Reassign employees when operationally required
Stock / Cash / Quality
□ Review daily inventory check
□ Monitor drinks, packaging and cleaning supplies
=====PAGE 7=====
MYGD | OPERATIONS & STATION CHECKLISTS
MYGD | Current opening hours: 11:30-22:00 daily | Hours may be adjusted | Page 7
□ Monitor bread, meat, sauces, salad and fries
□ Review Low Stock and Out of Stock lists
□ Monitor cash float and change
□ Record cash discrepancies immediately
□ Check product presentation and portion sizes
□ Check temperatures and freshness
□ Ensure MYGD standards are followed
MYGD Points
□ Complete daily MYGD Points evaluation
□ Recognise strong employee performance
□ Record improvement opportunities
□ Give immediate feedback where appropriate
CLOSING CHECKLIST
□ Close cash register
□ Count cash drawer
□ Complete daily cash reconciliation
□ Record any discrepancy
□ Secure cash
□ Close Foody / Wolt / other delivery systems
□ Log out of POS
□ Confirm all orders are completed
□ Confirm all stations are cleaned
□ Confirm all food is stored correctly
□ Check refrigerators
□ Check salad bar, sauce station, bread station, meat/hot station, fries and packing area
□ Check dishwashing and customer area
□ Check rubbish has been removed
□ Check floors
□ Record maintenance issues and stock shortages
□ Confirm restaurant is prepared for next day
□ Turn off required equipment and music
□ Check windows and doors
□ Activate alarm
□ Lock restaurant
PERFORMANCE STANDARD
The Shift Leader should always know the current situation in the restaurant: orders waiting, staffing, stock, cleanliness and
customer issues.

4. Meat / Hot Station
The Meat / Hot Station employee is responsible for ensuring a continuous supply of correctly prepared, hot, high-quality meat
throughout service. The station must never run out of ready-to-serve meat.
OPENING CHECKLIST
Meat Stock
□ Check chicken stock
□ Check beef stock
□ Check other meat products required for the day
□ Compare stock with expected sales
□ Inform Shift Leader immediately if stock is low
Konvektomat / Hot Equipment
□ Switch on Konvektomat
□ Check equipment is functioning correctly
□ Prepare first meat batch
□ Check correct programme / settings
□ Prepare hot holding area
□ Check required temperatures
□ Prepare clean GN containers
□ Prepare serving / portioning utensils
Workstation
□ Clean and sanitise workstation
□ Prepare cutting board if required
□ Prepare knives and tongs
□ Prepare scales / portioning tools if used
□ Ensure sanitiser and clean cloths are available
□ Make sure enough meat is ready for opening
DURING THE SHIFT
Meat Production
□ Produce meat according to MYGD procedure
□ Follow correct Konvektomat programme
□ Maintain correct food temperature
□ Keep a continuous supply of meat ready
□ Follow MYGD portion standards
□ Maintain consistent portions
□ Maintain product quality
□ Avoid overproduction
□ Minimise waste
Continuous Production Flow
READY BATCH → NEXT BATCH IN PRODUCTION → BACKUP STOCK AVAILABLE
□ Monitor chicken, beef and other meat stock
=====PAGE 9=====
MYGD | OPERATIONS & STATION CHECKLISTS
MYGD | Current opening hours: 11:30-22:00 daily | Hours may be adjusted | Page 9
□ Estimate upcoming requirement
□ Prepare next batch before current batch runs out
□ Inform Shift Leader of low stock
□ Record unusual waste
IMPORTANT: The Meat / Hot Station employee reports low stock but is not responsible for ordering unless specifically
authorised.
Workstation / Quiet Period
□ Keep station clean throughout service
□ Remove food waste immediately
□ Clean utensils regularly
□ Replace dirty GN containers
□ Keep equipment handles clean
□ Keep floor clean and dry
□ Check next meat batch
□ Clean Konvektomat exterior
□ Prepare clean GN containers
□ Assist Fries Station only when station remains covered
CLOSING CHECKLIST
□ Check remaining meat
□ Record remaining stock and waste
□ Store usable product according to food safety procedure
□ Dispose of product where required
□ Clean Konvektomat
□ Clean hot holding equipment
□ Clean GN containers
□ Clean knives, tongs and cutting boards
□ Clean and sanitise workstation
□ Clean shelves and handles
□ Remove food waste and rubbish
□ Sweep and mop floor
□ Leave station ready for next day
PERFORMANCE STANDARD
The Meat / Hot Station must never run out of ready-to-serve meat during service. The next batch must be started before the current
batch runs out.

5. Kitchen / Prep & Utility
The Kitchen / Prep & Utility Team Member prepares fresh ingredients, keeps production stations supplied, prepares selected
kitchen products, manages dishwashing and maintains cleanliness and hygiene throughout the kitchen.
OPENING CHECKLIST
Fresh Preparation
□ Wash all required vegetables
□ Prepare and cut lettuce
□ Prepare tomatoes
□ Prepare cucumbers
□ Prepare onions
□ Prepare red cabbage
□ Prepare additional salad ingredients
□ Fill salad GN containers
□ Prepare backup salad containers
□ Check freshness and quality
□ Label and date prepared products where required
Sauce Preparation
□ Prepare all required sauces
□ Fill sauce containers
□ Fill Sauce Bar
□ Prepare backup sauces
□ Check sauce consistency and quality
□ Label and date sauces where required
□ Refrigerate backup sauces correctly
Salad & Sauce Bar
□ Check Salad Bar refrigeration and temperature
□ Fully stock Salad Bar
□ Fully stock Sauce Bar
□ Prepare clean serving utensils
□ Ensure backup ingredients are available
□ Clean and sanitise the entire station
Fries Station
□ Check fryer
□ Switch on and preheat fryer
□ Check oil level and condition
□ Prepare French fries stock
□ Prepare fryer baskets
□ Prepare salt / seasoning
□ Prepare fries packaging
□ Check portion standard
□ Ensure station is clean and ready
=====PAGE 11=====
MYGD | OPERATIONS & STATION CHECKLISTS
MYGD | Current opening hours: 11:30-22:00 daily | Hours may be adjusted | Page 11
Pizza Station
□ Check pizza oven
□ Switch on and preheat pizza oven
□ Check pizza bases, sauce, cheese and toppings
□ Prepare pizza ingredients and utensils
□ Prepare pizza packaging
□ Ensure pizza station is clean and ready
Frozen Drinks
□ Check frozen drinks machine
□ Ensure machine is operating correctly
□ Check product level
□ Refill if required
□ Check cups, lids and straws
□ Clean dispensing area
General Kitchen
□ Clean and sanitise all work surfaces
□ Prepare chopping boards, knives and utensils
□ Prepare clean GN containers
□ Check cleaning cloths and sanitiser
□ Check rubbish bins and dishwashing area
□ Ensure floors are clean and dry
□ Ensure kitchen is fully prepared before service
DURING THE SHIFT
Production & Restocking
□ Monitor Salad Bar continuously
□ Refill ingredients before they run out
□ Prepare additional salad when required
□ Maintain backup GN containers
□ Refill sauces before they run out
□ Prepare additional sauce when required
□ Cook fries to MYGD standard
□ Prepare pizzas to MYGD standard
□ Prepare frozen drinks to order
□ Monitor kitchen stock and identify low stock early
IMPORTANT: During strong peaks, Fries should become a dedicated station whenever staffing allows.
Dishwashing
□ Wash dirty GN containers
□ Wash knives, chopping boards and utensils
□ Wash preparation equipment
□ Keep sink area clean
□ Keep dishwasher loaded and operating when required
□ Return clean equipment to correct station
=====PAGE 12=====
MYGD | OPERATIONS & STATION CHECKLISTS
MYGD | Current opening hours: 11:30-22:00 daily | Hours may be adjusted | Page 12
IMPORTANT: Dirty dishes must not be allowed to build up. During quiet periods, dishwashing should be brought completely up
to date before the next peak.
Quiet Period Priority
• 1. RESTOCK - Salad Bar, Sauce Bar, fries, pizza ingredients, frozen drinks, packaging
• 2. PREPARE - backup salad, vegetables, sauces, GN containers, next peak
• 3. CLEAN - dishes, preparation surfaces, fryers, pizza station, refrigerators, floors, rubbish
• 4. ORGANISE - refrigerators, FIFO, dates, dry storage, frozen stock, low-stock reporting
CLOSING CHECKLIST
□ Store all food correctly
□ Cover and refrigerate salads, vegetables and sauces
□ Label products where required
□ Follow FIFO
□ Dispose of food according to MYGD procedure
□ Record unusual waste
□ Wash GN containers and utensils
□ Clean Salad Bar and Sauce Bar
□ Clean fryer area and baskets
□ Manage / filter oil according to procedure
□ Store pizza ingredients correctly
□ Clean pizza area and oven according to procedure
□ Clean frozen drinks dispensing area
□ Complete all dishwashing
□ Clean dishwasher and sinks
□ Clean and sanitise all work surfaces
□ Organise refrigerators and storage
□ Empty rubbish bins
□ Sweep and mop floor
□ Ensure kitchen is prepared for next day
PERFORMANCE STANDARD
• All essential preparation must be completed before opening.
• No critical ingredient should run out during service.
• The kitchen must remain clean and organised throughout the shift.
• Low stock must be identified before it becomes Out of Stock.

6. Preparation / Assembly Team Member
The Preparation / Assembly Team Member is responsible for correctly assembling MYGD products according to the order, recipe
standards and customer modifications. The employee checks the individual product; the Expeditor / Shift Leader checks the
complete customer order.
OPENING CHECKLIST
Workstation
□ Clean and sanitise workstation
□ Prepare clean GN containers
□ Prepare utensils, tongs and portioning tools
□ Prepare knives where required
□ Check cutting boards
□ Ensure cleaning cloths and sanitiser are available
□ Check packaging required at the station
Ingredients & Order System
□ Check all required ingredients
□ Check Salad Bar and Sauce Bar
□ Check cheese and toppings
□ Check Döner, Dürüm, Burger and Bowl ingredients
□ Check required pizza ingredients where applicable
□ Check backup ingredients
□ Report missing products to Shift Leader
□ Check order screen / KDS
□ Check printer if used
□ Confirm special-order modifications are visible
DURING THE SHIFT
Food Preparation
□ Prepare every product according to the customer order
□ Follow MYGD recipes
□ Follow standard portion sizes
□ Follow correct production sequence
□ Read all customer modifications before starting the product
□ Assemble Döner correctly
□ Roll Dürüm correctly and tightly
□ Prepare Burgers according to MYGD standards
□ Prepare Bowls according to MYGD standards
□ Prepare Pizza according to assigned workflow
Special Orders / Modifications
• Examples: NO ONION, NO TOMATO, NO CUCUMBER, NO SAUCE, EXTRA SAUCE, EXTRA MEAT, NO CHEESE, EXTRA
CHEESE.
□ Read the complete modification before assembly
□ Keep modified products clearly identifiable
□ Never rely only on verbal communication
=====PAGE 14=====
MYGD | OPERATIONS & STATION CHECKLISTS
MYGD | Current opening hours: 11:30-22:00 daily | Hours may be adjusted | Page 14
□ Ask Shift Leader if the order is unclear
□ Never guess a customer modification
Product Quality Check
□ Correct product
□ Correct bread / wrap / bun / bowl
□ Correct protein
□ Correct ingredients
□ Correct sauces
□ Correct customer modifications
□ Correct portion
□ Correct presentation
□ Correct individual packaging
IMPORTANT: The Assembly employee checks the individual product. The Expeditor / Shift Leader performs the final check of
the complete customer order.
Speed & Communication
□ Begin orders immediately when they appear
□ Follow the correct order sequence
□ Work efficiently without sacrificing quality
□ Complete products within MYGD target production time
□ Communicate immediately when production is delayed
□ Avoid unnecessary movement away from the station
□ Communicate bread needs to Bread Station
□ Communicate meat needs and extra-meat orders to Meat / Hot Station
□ Communicate missing ingredients to Kitchen Crew
□ Hand completed products to the correct order / Expeditor
□ Inform Shift Leader about low stock, equipment problems or unclear orders
Stock & Cleanliness
□ Monitor ingredients continuously
□ Refill before containers are empty
□ Keep backup ingredients ready
□ Inform Kitchen / Prep before backup stock is exhausted
□ Keep workstation clean throughout shift
□ Clean spills immediately
□ Clean utensils regularly
□ Replace dirty utensils and GN containers
□ Remove food waste
□ Keep floor clean and dry
□ Keep ingredients organised
QUIET PERIOD
• RESTOCK - sauces, salad, toppings, cheese, wraps/buns, packaging
• PREPARE - backup ingredients, clean GN containers, next peak
• CLEAN - workstation, utensils, GN containers, shelves, handles, floor, rubbish
• SUPPORT - Packing / Expeditor, Kitchen / Prep, dishwashing, restocking, Bread Station if assigned

CLOSING CHECKLIST
□ Check remaining ingredients
□ Store all ingredients correctly
□ Cover, label and date products where required
□ Refrigerate products
□ Dispose of unusable food correctly
□ Report unusual waste
□ Empty and wash GN containers
□ Clean utensils, knives, tongs and cutting boards
□ Clean and sanitise workstation
□ Clean shelves and handles
□ Empty rubbish
□ Sweep and mop floor
□ Leave station ready for next shift
PERFORMANCE STANDARD
ORDER + MYGD RECIPE + CUSTOMER MODIFICATIONS
• No missing ingredients
• No incorrect ingredients or sauces
• No ignored modifications
• No incorrect portions
• Station remains CLEAN - STOCKED - ORGANISED - READY

7. Tablet Implementation Structure
• Opening - tasks required before the current opening time.
• Mid Shift - checks after lunch and preparation for dinner.
• Quiet Period - task queue used whenever there are no active orders.
• Evening / Closing - dinner preparation and closing duties.
• Inventory - numeric quantities with LOW / OUT alerts.
• Shift Leader Dashboard - status by station, incomplete critical tasks and verification.
Recommended Task Fields
□ Task name
□ Station / responsible role
□ Checkbox / status
□ Time or deadline where necessary
□ Employee name / initials
□ Comment / issue field
□ Shift Leader verification for critical tasks
Recommended Statuses
• Not Started
• In Progress
• Completed
• Verified
• Issue / Blocked
IMPORTANT: The opening time should be a configurable setting. The checklist deadline should automatically follow the active
opening time rather than being hard-coded to 11:30.

Final Operating Principle
CLEAN → RESTOCK → PREPARE → ORGANISE
Every station should be ready before it is needed - not after it becomes empty.
